name: K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B

lineage.how_derived: trained by IFM with open data, recipe, training code and intermediate checkpoints; family also contains dense 0.9B, 3.7B, 7B and 32B and a 375B-A23B MoE (repos IFM/K2-Horizon-*)

purpose: Fully open sparse member of the K2-Horizon family: frontier-class agentic and reasoning results at 4B active parameters, with released data, code and intermediate checkpoints for research (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo, text not read.

architecture.attention: MoVA (64 value experts, 4 active), 32 heads, head dim 128

pc-12gb.notes: 22.37 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~4 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 22.37 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~4 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 22.37 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~4 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-32gb.notes: 22.37 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 22.37 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 22.37 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 22.37 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF published, so llama.cpp support exists; MoVA is a new attention type, support level not verified.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
benchmarks.variant: BF16, reasoning high; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 44.9, Muse-Glimmer-30B 51.7, Gemma 4 31B 43.4, Nemotron 3 Super 38.6 (scores taken from Artificial Analysis by the vendor)

strengths: fully open (data, recipe, code, intermediate checkpoints)
high non-hallucination rate in the vendor's table
weaknesses: vendor table omits Qwen3.8-27B and Flint
soft.maturity: 15k downloads and 436 likes for this repo; the family spans 0.9B to 375B

tona_fit.reason: A 36B-A4B open model with a Terminal-Bench 2.1 score above Qwen3.6-35B-A3B in the vendor table and an open recipe. The attention type is new and the baseline is already Qwen3.8-27B, so it is a candidate only after an independent number appears.

open_questions: speed of MoVA attention in llama.cpp
the smaller dense K2-Horizon models (0.9B, 3.7B, 7B, 32B) not recorded here
